command: Review native E. coli nitrogen-PTS ptsP

Review all seeded rows while preserving ordered source payloads and qualifiers. Distinguish native PtsP-NPr-PtsN phosphotransfer from in-vitro crosstalk and other-species outputs. Use actual tree/PAINT ancestry and target evidence without guessed losses. No NEW rows; document abstract/full-text limits and the shared failed Falcon attempt. Focused gene, reference and preservation checks plus helper-history validation and render are recorded in the owned consultation.
render_gene_review(genes/ECOLI/ptsP/ptsP-ai-review.yaml) with adjacent temporary output then atomic rename
